expectations.text: Refuses to move the announced 6 February date and states that scope moves instead
expectations.evidence: "Do not slide to March... the date holds and scope moves."

expectations.text: Gives the reason as trust burned with speakers, sponsors and attendees, not as logistical difficulty or cost
expectations.evidence: "Moving it burns trust with speakers, sponsors and ticket holders."

expectations.text: Rebuilds the actual state per track - milestones done, late, or not started - against the plan rather than against memory
expectations.evidence: It only says "Today, A and B list what is scored, offered and signed"; no per-track state is rebuilt against a plan.

expectations.text: Recomputes each track's remaining runway to its terminal milestone and flags every gate now at risk
expectations.evidence: It covers the holiday dead zone but gives no per-track runway recomputation or gates-at-risk list.

expectations.text: Spends buffers in order: un-spent latest-safe slack first, then a scope-tier downgrade if a ladder exists, then scope cuts
expectations.evidence: The order is not stated; it holds Thursday commitments open and uses a ladder, but never spells out the sequence.

expectations.text: Cuts scope at the gate level, removing the item whose removal unblocks the most downstream milestones rather than the item that is furthest behind
expectations.evidence: "Gate logic says to cut the item whose removal unblocks the most downstream work."

expectations.text: Evaluates cancelling the Thursday workshop day by how many downstream milestones it unblocks rather than accepting or rejecting it on the board's preference
expectations.evidence: "The board is right about the type of lever... wrong about the timing"; Thursday is "the best candidate for the first downgrade" because of the venue day, instructors and catering.

expectations.text: Warns that the speaker-confirmation-to-program-announcement segment cannot be compressed to zero, because speakers need employer approval and travel arrangements
expectations.evidence: No mention of employer approval or travel arrangements limiting that segment.

expectations.text: States that spending money recovers execution slips but not calendar physics: a compressed CFP stays compressed
expectations.evidence: "Budget buys execution speed... It does not buy calendar time."

expectations.text: Rewrites the remaining checkpoints against the new plan rather than carrying the old conditions forward
expectations.evidence: New checkpoints are written, but it never frames them as rewriting existing conditions.

expectations.text: Explains that keeping the old checkpoint conditions would re-fire them immediately
expectations.evidence: Not stated.

expectations.text: Tells the user explicitly which lever was spent and what it bought
expectations.evidence: No statement of a lever spent.
